scope: Cross-run comparison of one CTest case between two acceptance-matrix runs. It shows whether the two runs bind to the same source, and what each run recorded for the case, so an intermittent failure cannot be read as a source difference.

reading: Same HEAD, same per-file hash map and same configure cache: the case passed in the earlier run and failed in the later one under the same build configuration, so the failure is not attributable to a source or configuration change.
